blind.description: A cubic block representing a trimmed square bush or foliage block. The surface is composed of repetitive, scalloped, overlapping leaf-like or scale-like rounded lobes. The material is glossy, vibrant green with slightly exposed pale grey/white seams and highlights underneath the lobes. The structure forms a cohesive cube that sits flat on the ground without an external pedestal.
blind.from_above: A square top surface with rounded corners, covered in mottled glossy green bumps and scattered whitish highlights, resembling the flat trimmed top of an ornamental hedge.
defects: repetitive tiled shell geometry with visible pale internal seams between lobes
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 60-70% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 3.5 to 4 ft tall) and roughly 3.5 to 4 ft wide and deep.
